main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess forward 10-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; inconclusive if fewer than 100 non-overlapping blocks with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: share of positive fwd 10-bar returns on forecast>0 bars minus coin's share over all bars

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2: inconclusive.
reading: The coin's holding mean and positive share use all overlapping 10-bar returns of all its windows, the regression is OLS with intercept on grid bars 0,10,20,... of each window, and the supporting check pools all forecast>0 bars, each compared with its own coin's share.
